# 聖殿騎士級攔截飛船
[color=#a4885c]船隻大小：[/color] 小型
[color=#a4885c]艦隊穿梭機：[/color] 否
[color=#a4885c]建議乘員人數：[/color] 1-2 人
[color=#a4885c]發電類型：[/color] APU
[color=#a4885c]遠征任務：[/color] 無
[color=#a4885c]敵我識別 (IFF) 控制台：[/color] 有
[color=#a4885c]最低存取權限：[/color] 副手
「一款專為戰鬥攔截行動設計的小型安全突擊艦。」
# 關於運行 NSF 聖殿騎士號穿梭機的要訣 - 聖殿騎士號的穿梭機輔助動力單元（APU）最高可支援 [color=#a4885c]12 [bold]kW[/bold][/color]。 It is not recommended to go above this due to the small interior space. For more general information on the power grid and other life support systems, refer to the [textlink="Power" link="Power"] guidebook article and the [textlink="Preflight Checklist" link="PreflightChecklist"/]. - For the basics of [bold]shuttle piloting[/bold], refer to [textlink="Piloting" link="Piloting"] and [textlink="Sector Topology" link="SectorTopology"/]. - For the basics of [bold]cargo hauling[/bold], refer to [textlink="Cargo Hauling" link="CargoHauling"]. - For the basics of [bold]expedition diving[/bold], refer to [textlink="Expeditions" link="Expeditions"]. - As a Captain of a Nanotrasen vessel, you have the authority to hire, fire, demote, or promote crew members at will, refer to [textlink="Hiring" link="Hiring"] for more information.
